{{Quote|Hangar control, stand down!|The deck officer|<ref name="Chapter 16" />}}
A [[human]] [[Gender|male]] served as a '''deck officer''' in [[Moff]] [[Gideon]]'s [[Galactic Empire]] [[Gideon's Imperial remnant|remnant]] aboard [[Gideon's light cruiser]] at the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[lieutenant]]. When the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] [[Operating number|designated]] [[Shuttle 2743]] was chased by the [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft|''Firespray''-31-class patrol and attack craft]] ''[[Slave I]]'' in [[9 ABY]], the [[deck officer]] helped clear the launch tube of the [[light cruiser]] by halting the launch of additional [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighters]], allowing the [[shuttle]] to land in the [[hangar]]. Infiltrators aboard the [[Starship|vessel]] then exited and [[Death|killed]] personnel in the hangar.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Clear launch tube immediately.|Elia Kane's orders|<ref name="Chapter 16" />}}
[[File:ImpDeckOfficerRunForCover-TMCh16.png|thumb|left|300px|The deck officer runs for cover as the shuttle crashes into the hangar.]]
The [[deck officer]] served in a [[Gideon's Imperial remnant|remnant]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] led by [[Moff]] [[Gideon]], stationed aboard [[Gideon's light cruiser]] and holding the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[lieutenant]].<ref name="Chapter 16" /> In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|16}}</ref> a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] designated [[Shuttle 2743]] was pursued by the [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft|''Firespray''-31-class patrol and attack craft]] ''[[Slave I]]''. The [[light cruiser]]'s hangar deployed two [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighters]], but orders soon came from [[Elia Kane]] stationed at the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] to clear the launch tube for the [[shuttle]] to land.<ref name="Chapter 16" />

The deck [[Imperial officer|officer]] ordered hangar control to stand down through his [[comlink]] and halted a [[TIE series|TIE]] which was getting ready to launch. The [[officer]] then watched Shuttle 2743 approach the launch tube, rushing out of the way when the shuttle landed into the hangar at high speed. From the [[Starship|vessel]] came an infiltration team consisting of [[Bo-Katan Kryze]], [[Carasynthia Dune|Cara Dune]], [[Fennec Shand]], and [[Koska Reeves]], [[Death|killing]] everyone in their path.<ref name="Chapter 16" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa!|The deck officer stops a TIE fighter from launching|<ref name="Chapter 16" />}}
[[File:ImpDeckOfficerOrders-TMCh16.png|thumb|right|300px|The deck officer gives orders to halt launch of TIE fighters.]]
The deck officer was a [[human]] male with [[Color|light]] skin, dark [[hair]] and brown [[eye]]s. Upon orders to clear the launch tube, he moved hastily to halt the launch of TIE fighters.<ref name="Chapter 16" />

==Equipment==
The deck officer wore the [[Clothing|wore]] the standard [[Imperial officer's uniform|uniform]] of an Imperial naval officer, including an [[Imperial kepi]] and a [[code cylinder]]s attached below his left shoulder, one of which he used to access his terminal. He wore a [[rank insignia plaque]] on his left [[breast]] with two red bars above two blue,<ref name="Chapter 16" /> which signified the rank of lieutenant.<ref name="Spark">''[[Star Wars Rebels: Spark of Rebellion]]''</ref> The officer possessed a comlink and a [[SE-14r light repeating blaster]] that was [[holster]]ed on his right hip.<ref name="Chapter 16" />

==Behind the scenes==
The deck officer first appeared in "[[Chapter 16: The Rescue]]" of [[Jon Favreau]]'s [[2019]] [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', directed by [[Peyton Reed]]<ref name="Chapter 16" /> and released on [[December 18]], [[2020]].<ref name="D23">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-december-2020|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in December 2020}}</ref> Identified as "deck officer" in the episode's audio description,<ref name="Chapter 16" /> he was played by [[Stephen Bralver]].<ref name="Stephen Bralver YouTube">{{YouTube|video=6_YlehhZEhU|text=Stephen Bralver Actor Reel | MANDALORIAN|channel=ROOKIE | HAWAII FIVE-0|name=channel/UCJ0w-ip8CMoy-BKbvRz7VhA|archivedate=20201222062624}}</ref>
